    set hostname "FW-CAP-01"
    set admintimeout 5
    set strong-crypto enable
end
config system interface
    edit "wan1"
        set vdom "root"
        set ip 198.18.10.2 255.255.255.252
        set allowaccess ping
        set role wan
    next
end

    edit "admin"
